dedupe_keys.name: database of cold formed steel coupon properties at elevated temperatures

description: Database of cold-formed steel coupon properties at elevated temperatures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Thomas Gernay, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). This project compiles test data on cold-formed steel (CFS) material properties at elevated temperatures obtained from coupon tests published in the literature. The data supports evaluation of the elevated temperature response of CFS members and structures for structural fire analysis and design. The data has been compiled from 33 studies published between 2000 and 2025. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV, XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gt8a-w118. Keywords: Cold-formed Steel,  Elevated temperatures, Material properties, Test data,  steady-state tests,  Transient tests. Published 2026-04-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
